qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Kuehne+Nagel is the global #1 ocean freight forwarder and a top-3 air forwarder with scale economies shared and proprietary digital routing platforms (Seaexplorer). However, enterprise shippers face low switching costs and routinely tender shipping lanes across competing forwarders, leaving K+N as a price-taking intermediary without independent pricing power >= inflation across the freight cycle.
qualitative.note: Rejected at Gate 3b (Pricing & Proof of Moat). Kuehne+Nagel is an asset-light global forwarding leader with high return on equity and stable anchor ownership by Klaus-Michael Kühne. However, third-party logistics forwarding is structurally intermediated and subject to frequent customer RFQs; EBIT halved from 2022 peaks as global ocean/air freight spreads normalized, confirming that margins are market-driven rather than protected by proprietary pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Group revenue declined from CHF 39.4B (2022) to CHF 23.8B (2023) and EBIT fell ~50% from CHF 3.76B to CHF 1.90B as abnormal pandemic supply-chain surcharges vanished. Core Sea and Air logistics volumes are re-tendered regularly by corporate customers on commodity freight rates with negligible customer lock-in.
